definitions.gloss: slim build; slender figure; thin physique
definitions.explanation: Describes a person or object that is thin and slender. When used about people, it refers to a naturally slim body type. When used about objects, it means narrow or slim in design.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{細身|ほそみ}の{体型|たいけい}だ。
{細身|ほそみ}のジーンズが{似合|にあ}う。
examples.english: Slim-fit jeans look good on you.

examples.japanese: {細身|ほそみ}でスタイルが{良|よ}いので、{何|なに}を{着|き}ても{格好良|かっこよ}く{見|み}える。
examples.english: Because of her slim figure, she looks good in anything she wears.

notes:
Composed of {細|ほそ} (thin, slender) + {身|み} (body). Functions as both a noun and a の-adjective: {細身|ほそみ}の～. Generally a neutral or positive descriptor, unlike words like {痩|や}せている which can imply being too thin.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細身|ほそみ}の{体型|たいけい}: slim body type
- {細身|ほそみ}のパンツ: slim-fit pants
- {細身|ほそみ}のデザイン: slim/sleek design
- {細身|ほそみ}の{男性|だんせい}: a slim man

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スリム: slim — loanword, often used in fashion and body image contexts
- {華奢|きゃしゃ}: delicate, slender — implies fragile elegance, often used for women
- {痩|や}せ{型|がた}: thin build — more clinical, can imply underweight
